metadata.title: Ethiopian Food Composition Table 2025
metadata.citation: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI) and Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO). 2025. The Ethiopian Food Composition Table 2025. Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
metadata.copyright: © Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI), 2025. Reproduced with acknowledgement; no endorsement is implied.
metadata.basis: Per 100 g edible portion, fresh weight basis; edible is a coefficient, not a nutrient amount.
limitations: Harvest, maturity, preparation and cooking conditions are available only when specified by the source food description.
Trace and missing values are null, not zero. Bracketed source values are lower quality.
The source table combines energy kJ(kcal); both source units are represented separately.
The condensed PDF contains 39 nutritional component columns plus an edible portion coefficient. It does not contain the complete 69-component Excel dataset.

The guide declares 727 foods, but its condensed table contains 722 distinct printed food codes: 43 roots/tubers versus 44 declared, and 37 condiments/spices versus 41 declared. Missing rows have not been invented.

The cereal retinol column contains an apparent sequential-number error in the PDF itself. All 157 affected entries retain the printed value and carry a source-anomaly quality flag; exclude these values from nutritional recommendations.
Food state, methods, timings and conditions are simple description-derived search aids, not publisher classification. Source descriptions remain authoritative.
